title: The Falconer (character)
description:
[h2]The Falconer: a new playable character[/h2]
A hunter and her peregrine falcon. [b]Send[/b] the falcon on [b]Errands[/b] (Hunt, Stoop, Scout, Fetch, Harry, Forage); it comes back with the result. [b]Perched[/b] cards want it home, [b]Alone[/b] cards want it away.
The falcon grows over the run: it gains XP and Levels from fights, and learns [b]Traits[/b] at rest sites (new option: Fly). Send cards can target an ally in co-op.

HP 72. Starting relic: Falconer's Glove. 68 cards.

[h3]Good to know[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changes gameplay: everyone in a multiplayer lobby needs the same version.
[*]Requires BaseLib (subscribed automatically as a required item).
[*]Personal fan project, not affiliated with Mega Crit.
[/list]
changeNote: v0.1.0: first version of the Falconer.
